_readme: How a commentary NAMES a lexicon when citing it, mapped to the kosha slug under data/kosha/. Data rather than code, so adding a lexicon or a spelling is an edit here and nothing else. A name alone is never a citation -- reference_detect.py's KoshaDetector requires a citation frame (इति, उक्त, कोशे) around a bare name, because अमर on its own means 'deathless' and धनञ्जय is a name people have. Names that already carry their own frame (अमरकोशे, इत्यामरः) are accepted as they stand.

unresolved._note: Named in commentaries but not (yet) a lexicon this library holds. Listed so the gap is visible rather than silently unlinked.
